name: Ayush Vaishnav
comment: Excellent and quick dry cleaning service. My old blazer was stained with food items, but they made it look brand new within 24 hours. Awesome experience — looking forward to availing other services!

name: Adarsh Singh
comment: Excellent dry cleaning setup for all types of clothes. They use German organic chemicals and softeners for maximum cleaning and fabric care. Gave blankets and suits — got them cleaned in 12 hours. Highly recommended.

name: Vikas Chaudhary
comment: Very nice optimized automated cleaning as per fabric requirements, rejuvenating the fabric. Nice and clean hygienic packing. Must try — one of the best in the city for all kinds of laundry and dry cleaning.

name: Alok Pratap Singh
comment: I live in Canada and came back after a year. The condition of my sofa was a mess. A friend told me about MyCleaners and I'm amazed — they really made me happy with their work.

name: Priya Sharma
comment: Honestly surprised by the quality. They picked up my clothes on time and delivered them perfectly pressed. The app makes scheduling so easy. Will definitely use again.

name: Rohit Verma
comment: Best laundry service in Jaipur by far. Affordable pricing, professional staff, and the clothes come back smelling fresh. The express delivery option is a lifesaver!
